title: The Dragon issue-24 opener part two: the alignment pantheon (census 878)

banner.title: The Dragon issue-24 opener part two - the alignment pantheon
banner.provenance: The part-two round of the issue-24 four-round shape - the single chain of the Schick Design Forum alignment variant, the table round of the walk: choir practice at the First Church of Lawful Evil (Orthodox), The Ramifications of Alignment - the eighteen prime alignments across Law, Neutrality and Chaos, the twenty-one prime deities with the four elemental lords at two hundred hit points, the five sons of Thakta Tylden and the Headsman of Marly, the fourteen-spell standard god list, the gods created and maintained by their believers worship. Pinned from The Dragon Vol. III No. 10, April 1979, number 24, print 34 and 36 through 39 - print 35 is the In Search of the Unknown module advertisement.

tables.name: s24Pantheon
tables.audit_comment: the pantheon grid - the twenty-one prime deities in roster order, six Law, five Neutrality singles plus the four elemental lords, six Chaos, with the printed armor class, hit points, move, second move and damage pair
col_comments: the armor class - negative better, the Morilirom irrelevant armor class carried as the sentinel
the hit points - the prime three hundred, the elemental lords two hundred

the printed move - the Hisk, Bleskuta, Temanamat, Golod, Sog-Morthoth and Thakta Tylden feet marks against the inch moves of the rest, the Morilirom and Karnawenn instantaneous moves carried as the sentinel
the second printed move - the Shaliroi thirty-six in water, the sentinel otherwise

the damage low die - the Marly staff, the Tholtanooma hammer, the Rasan Korya sword, the Rillifloham fists, the Gungger fists, the Hara hands, the Zkracl hands, the Shaliroi hands, the Bleskuta club, the Golod claws and the Thakta Tylden whip, the sentinel where the article prints no damage pair
the damage high die - the same printed pairs, the sentinel where the article prints none

tables.name: s24Sons
tables.audit_comment: the sons grid - the five Thakta Tylden sons, the Lakunth Weretiger, the Pakunth Stone Giant, the Rakunth Orcish demi-god, the Quakunth winged Troll and the Dakunth Type VI Demon printing on page 39
col_comments: the son armor class - the Lakunth minus one through the Pakunth four
the son hit points - the seventy-five through the ninety
the son magic resistance - the Pakunth fifty and the Dakunth eighty-five printed, the sentinel for the three without a printed resistance
the son level - the Lakunth fifteenth, the Quakunth tenth and the Dakunth twentieth printed, the sentinel for the giant and the demi-god
the son attacks per round - only the Rakunth three printed, the sentinel for the rest

tables.name: s24Aligns
tables.audit_comment: the alignment roster - the eighteen prime alignments in print order with the axis, the slot letter and the prime deity index into the pantheon grid, the Four Elements pointing at Gungger, the first of the four lords
